message_text: Does the career center help with resume reviews?
Yes! We offer drop-in resume reviews every Tuesday and Thursday from 1-4pm, or you can schedule a one-on-one appointment with a career counselor.
I'm graduating in December and starting my job search. Any resources for that?
We have several resources: our job board (Handshake), career fairs each semester, mock interview sessions, LinkedIn profile reviews, and alumni networking events.
When is the next career fair?
The Fall Career Fair is September 28th in the Student Center. Over 120 employers are registered. Pre-register on Handshake to get your resume in front of recruiters beforehand.
That's amazing, I had no idea there were so many resources. Thank you!
We're here to help you succeed! Good luck with your job search.
